reference.title: Appendix: Supported File Formats
reference.shortdesc: Recording container and image formats OBS Studio can write or read.

section.title: Recording containers
section.p: MP4, MOV, MKV, FLV, TS, and hybrid MP4 (a self-repairing variant recommended when recording long, unattended sessions).

section.title: Image source formats
section.p: PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF (including animated GIF playback), and TGA.
